title: Two searchable lists
text: Available and Selected, each with search and a live item count.

title: Keyboard first
text: Multi-select listboxes: Space, Shift ranges, Ctrl+A, Enter to move, type-ahead.

title: Drag, optionally
text: Drag items between the lists; the move buttons are always the alternative.

title: 10,000 items
text: Windowed rows keep long lists fast, with positions announced in the full list.

title: Form ready
text: Required, minimum, and maximum counts; one hidden input per selected value.
